import json
D='/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr'
ps=json.load(open(D+'/positions.json'))
cl=[p for p in ps if p.get('status')=='closed']; op=[p for p in ps if p.get('status')=='open']
real=sum(p.get('pnl_usd',0) for p in cl)
print('closed',len(cl),'open',len(op),'realized %.3f'%real,'equity_real %.3f'%(7+real))
w=sum(1 for p in cl if p.get('pnl_usd',0)>0); print('wins',w,'losses',len(cl)-w)
print('open margin %.2f'%sum(p['stake']/p.get('lev',5)*p.get('rem',1) for p in op))
PY
